title: Aufrüsten: from cold to departure
intro: A cold-start service finds the BR 101 dark with the parking brake on; a timetable service loads it with the cab unoccupied, SiFa isolated and the LZB/PZB breaker open. On a loco that is already powered, start at step 8.

steps.text: Loco under the wire; parking brake light (Federspeicher anlegen) on.
Battery (Batterie) ON; the voltage must read above 95 V.
Pantograph selector to Auto (or the one you want); every LSS breaker on this wall set.
Open the SIFA and the red PZB/LZB cut-off valves; all others open except drain, towing, bypass and relay.
Set every breaker, including LSS 44F01 LZB/PZB-Hauptschalter in the third row.
Auxiliary reservoir under 7 bar: close LSS 34F05 (auxiliary compressor); if it will not run, drain below 4.8 bar first.
Leave the machine room before raising the pantograph: entering it with the Hauptschalter closed is prohibited.
Sit down; Fahrschalter (power handle) at Off, or the reverser will not move.
Reverser key in and brake key unlocked; keep PARK BRK up, the key is held only while it is.
Richtungsschalter from Off to Neutral; wait for the screens to boot (over a minute).
Raise the pantograph (SA heben), close the Hauptschalter (HS ein). 'Druckluft HS zu gering' = under 7 bar.
Press [St] and check for faults.
Lights as required; off on an end coupled to a coach.
NBÜ/ep switch to 0 in both cabs; pn/el switch to pn.
Führerbremsventil to Running; ease the direct brake until the C-pressure is below 0.5 bar.
Parking brake light stays lit; wait for the main reservoir (red needle) to reach 10 bar.
pn test: brake pipe down to 4.2 bar, C-pressure rises on both bogies; release.
pn/el switch to el and repeat the 4.2 bar application and release.
Direct brake to 2 bar C-pressure, release, then apply it again to hold the loco.
SiFa and PZB to normal (LZB / INDUSI buttons on the ZDE panel). LZB stays isolated only light or under four braked coaches.
For the PZB/LZB test: Forward, brake key unlocked, train brake released, direct brake on.
Press Prüftaste/Stör: lamps and sounds, two emergency applications, LZB calibration; then Prüftaste Lampen.
SiFa test: hold the pedal (Q): light at 30 s, 'SIFA' 2.5 s later, Zwangsbremsung 2.5 s after that.
Test the horn.
Brake test: brake pipe 5 bar, brake key locked 60 s, it may drop 0.3 bar at most; unlock.
Brake to 4.2 bar; with a cab car lock the brake key 10 s, the pipe must not rise.
Walk the train: every coach braked, then released. A sticking coach: overcharge to 5.3–5.5 bar.
With a cab car: hold Continuity Test until the main reservoir drops below 5 bar; it must climb to 8.
BRA: 9 for passenger; 2 freight in G, 4 freight in P.
Brh: EBuLa [0], [9] SD, [2] Brh berechnen; enter braked weight and mass, [E].
Convert it with the ZDE sheet (Brh im Zug) to the BRH to enter; a typical IC is 180, entered as 18.
ZL: length in tens of metres, rounded up (254 m = 26). VMZ: lowest limit in tens (200 km/h = 20).
Set BRA, BRH, ZL, VMZ, press ZD. [55] and [Stör] flashing = base data (Grunddaten) still active.
Check: hold PZB Wachsam and PZB Frei together; the MFA shows the data.
Enter the train number and set up the GSM-R radio.
Richtungsschalter to Forward; hold the ZS (train supply) switch at Start until 'ZS Aus' goes out.
Release the doors on the platform side; after 'Schließvorgang eingeleitet' and Zp 9, back to Lock All.
Parking brake off: with 1.5 bar or more C-pressure press the right (release) button.
Führerbremsventil to Running, release the direct brake (keep it on until power on a gradient).
Fahrschalter through Min upwards; or AFB on ('AFB' three times), Fahrschalter to 0 once, set the speed.
On the move: SiFa reset, PZB Wachsam, Frei, Befehl 40.
steps.tca: Gear lever / ENG 2 / ENG 1 / Round aux

steps.text: Leaving: full service, parking brake on (left button), brake key locked, reverser Off and out.

notes: Reverser stuck: keep PARK BRK up (the reverser key is held only while it is) and the Fahrschalter at Off ('Z-Steller nicht in Null').
No pantograph or Hauptschalter: the auxiliary reservoir needs 3.5 bar for the pantograph, 7 bar for the HS (LSS 34F05, or drain below 4.8 bar).
PARK BRK moves both keys. For the brake-key leak tests, lock the brake key in the cab with the mouse so the reverser key stays in.
AFB will not take: brake on el with the HSM breaker set, train data entered, brake key unlocked, Forward, Fahrschalter back to 0 once.
SiFa / PZB dead: open their cut-off valves and set LSS 44F01 first; the aux squares only switch the isolation buttons.
source: Source: BR 101 & Cab-Car Expert Manual, Final Version 3.0, Train Sim Germany
